visual_review.scope: Visual non-worsening screen only; not an endorsement of reconstruction fidelity or improvement
visual_review.review_method: Unblinded inspection of all three raw and finished comparison sheets, full face and supplied-hole crops. No clear additional visual artifact attributable to the SSIM arm at these displayed scales. Numerical gate is independently failed.

notes.263: Raw and finished outputs retain forward-facing gaze instead of the original sideways gaze, lighter blue/green irises, and altered angular brows. SSIM and epsilon continuations look nearly identical at full-face and crop scales; no clear new seam or structural artifact is visible. This is not a recovery of the original eye geometry.
notes.6681: Both raw and finished SSIM retain excessively cyan iris colour with an irregular bright patch at the image-right eye, altered lids and sparse/light eyebrows. These are also present in the controls; no clear extra artifact appears in SSIM. Finished compositing restores surrounding appearance, but does not fix the eye details.
notes.10149: The SSIM result retains upward/pale gaze, narrower eye opening and flatter/thinner brow shapes than the original. Its visible geometry is nearly indistinguishable from the local/prior/epsilon controls; no clear additional artifact is seen. The raw full-image colour shift remains in all arms and is removed outside the hole by finishing. The original expression is not restored.

limitations: Three fixed development identities and inference seed17; no generalization or accuracy percentage claim
Trained checkpoint is a matched 32-update continuation per arm after the common 64-update pilot, at 512 resolution evaluated at 1024 and exported at 512
Hole SSIM uses fully contained 11x11 windows; hole/eye LPIPS uses fixed contextual crops
ArcFace belongs to the generation conditioning family; FaceNet is separate from conditioning
Visible RGB is preserved by final compositing; retained raw outputs may differ there
Numerical gate and completed visual review are both required before proposing replication; no website promotion
